{{Top|leg}}
'''Clearplas''' was a  transparent material.<ref name="Crucible">[[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']]</ref> An [[Computer/Legends|interface console]] in the [[Jedi Temple's computer core|computer core room]] of the [[New Jedi Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] contained clearplas. In [[45 ABY]], during an [[Assault on the New Jedi Temple|assault]] on the New Jedi Temple, the [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Saba Sebatyne]] was thrown against an interface console in the computer core room by the [[The Force/Legends|Force]] entity [[Abeloth]], resulting in the shattering of the console's clearplas components.<ref name="Apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref> Vats in a [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] at the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Base Prime]] in the [[Chiloon Rift/Legends|Chiloon Rift]] used for growing [[biot]]s were fitted with clearplas fronts.<ref name="Crucible" />
 
==Behind the scenes==
Clearplas first appeared in the [[2012]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]'', which was written by [[Troy Denning]] and served as the final instalment of the ''[[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi]]'' book series.<ref name="Apocalypse" /> Clearplas was subsequently referenced in the [[2013]] novel [[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']], also by Denning.<ref name="Crucible" />
